"""Main closes R200 malformed path-credit gap, preserving raw limit accounting."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'xe-v0143-leaf-canonical-path-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    paths = ['src/core/conversation_memory.cpp', 'tests/core/memory_guard_test.cpp']
    r = dict(passed=False, active=False, complete=True, scope='SourceOnly R200 correction',
             gpu_executed=False, controller_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), before={p: sha(W / p) for p in paths})
    try:
        p = W / paths[0]
        s = p.read_text()
        old = "    exact = !group.empty() && group.front() == '/' && dirs.size() == names.size() + 1;"
        assert s.count(old) == 1
        new = "    const bool canonical = !group.empty() && group.front() == '/' && group.back() != '/' &&\n" \
              "        group.find(\"//\") == std::string::npos;\n" \
              "    exact = canonical && !names.empty() && dirs.size() == names.size() + 1;"
        p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
        p = W / paths[1]
        s = p.read_text()
        old = '        f.self("0::/a/b\\n0::/a/b");'
        assert s.count(old) == 1
        new = '''        for (const char* path : {"0::/a//b", "0:://a/b", "0::/a/b/", "0::a/b"}) {
            f.self(path);
            r = f.sample();
            check(r && r->available == 0 && r->credit == 0,
                  "noncanonical membership keeps raw limits and grants no cache credit");
        }
'''
        p.write_text(s.replace(old, new + old))
        r['passed'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    r['after'] = {p: sha(W / p) for p in paths}
    (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error']}))
